name: Traditional Uppukandam
shortDescription: Traditional Tamil cured and dried goat meat — distinctly concentrated in flavour for pan-frying or slow-simmered gravies, rather than fresh raw meat.
summaryIntro: Uppukandam (உப்புக்கண்டம்) is an age-old Tamil preserved goat meat preparation made by curing and drying meat pieces. Unlike fresh meat, it requires light pounding and quick cooking before serving.
highlights: Dried goat meat speciality rooted in Tamil culinary tradition
Prepared in small farm batches rather than mass retail packs
Pack sizes, spice profile, and batch dates confirmed by the farm
